name: Mountain climber

phases.name: left drive
phases.cue: Drive your left knee in towards your chest

phases.name: left back
phases.cue: Step it back to the plank

phases.name: right drive
phases.cue: Drive your right knee in towards your chest

formTips: Keep your hands under your shoulders and arms long
Hold a straight line from your head to your heels
Drive each knee in under your chest
Keep your hips level as the legs switch
commonMistakes: Shoulders drifting back behind the hands
Bouncing the hips up and down
